instructions: The night before, move the box of phyllo from the freezer to the fridge to thaw.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Put the spinach in a large colander, sprinkle 1/2 tsp of the salt over it and toss it with your hands. Leave it for 10 minutes. The leaves will darken and start to go limp.

Meanwhile, crumble the 6 oz of feta into a large bowl. Thinly slice 2 of the green onions, finely chop 2 tbsp of the mint and 1 tbsp of the dill, and mince the 2 garlic cloves. Add them all to the bowl.

Zest the lemon over the bowl until you have about 1/2 tsp, then squeeze in 1/2 tbsp of its juice. Add 1/2 cup of the Greek yogurt, the 1/2 tsp nutmeg, the 1/4 tsp pepper and the remaining 1/4 tsp salt.

Put a big handful of the spinach in the middle of a clean kitchen towel and twist it tight over the sink until no more water drips out. Do the same with the rest. Squeeze hard, or the filling will be wet and the bottom of the pie will go soggy.
Add the squeezed spinach to the bowl and mix everything with your hands, pulling the clumps apart as you go. Taste a little of it. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt.
Crack the egg into the bowl and stir until the filling looks evenly coated.
Melt the 8 tbsp of butter in a small pan over low heat. Finely grate the parmesan until you have 2/3 cup.
Unroll the phyllo and count out 16 sheets. Cover them with a damp kitchen towel. Keep them covered while you work, or they dry out and crack.
Lay 1 sheet on the baking sheet and brush it all over with butter. Lay a second sheet on top and brush it too. Keep going until you have a stack of 8 buttered sheets.
Spread the filling over the stack in an even layer, leaving a 1 inch border bare all the way around.
Lay a sheet over the filling, brush it with butter and scatter about 2 tbsp of the parmesan over it. Do the same with 4 more sheets, so all the parmesan is used.
Lay the last 3 sheets on top, brushing butter between them, with no cheese. Press the edges down all the way around to seal the pie.
Brush the top with the rest of the butter and sprinkle the 1 tsp sesame seeds over it.
Bake for about 25 minutes, until the top is deep golden and crisp and sounds papery when you tap it.
Let it sit on the baking sheet for 5 minutes, then cut it into 4 pieces with a sharp knife.
Serve it hot, straight from the oven.
advance_prep_notes: Thaw the phyllo in the fridge overnight, the night before.
method_notes: Both versions fill layered phyllo with spinach, feta, green onions and herbs bound with egg. RecipeTin Eats salts raw spinach to sweat it, wrings it dry and adds Greek yogurt, mint, dill, lemon, garlic and nutmeg, then builds a free-form pie on a tray with buttered sheets and kefalotyri scattered between the top layers. Dimitras Dishes uses ricotta as well as feta, brushes with olive oil instead of butter, crumples the top sheets and bakes a big tray for an hour at a lower heat. This one follows RecipeTin Eats at 4 servings, with parmesan in place of kefalotyri.
